meta.title: Refactor CLI parsing to separate syntax parsing from option validation
meta.body_summary: Refactor CLI parsing to separate syntax parsing from option validation, avoiding loading the full FFmpeg options dictionary and thus reducing package size and improving parsing speed.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot refactored CLI parsing to avoid loading full options dictionary; PR closed by maintainer after ~30h with no review engagement and no performance evidence.
